5283.title: [Config] tune(dsv4): gfx950 FP8 blockscale bpreshuffle for wq_b / wqkv_a
5283.body:
Retune 60 gfx950 (cu_num=256) entries in the DeepSeek-V4 model config for the two DP-attention (attn_tp_size=1) MLA linear shapes:

  wq_b   (q_b_proj)         ColumnParallelLinear(q_lora_rank=1536 -> n_heads*head_dim=65536)
                            N=65536, K=1536  (unsharded under DP attention)
  wqkv_a (fused q_a + kv_a) ReplicatedLinear(hidden=7168 -> q_lora_rank+head_dim=2048)
                            N=2048,  K=7168

All 60 rows are in-place replacements of existing keys (no rows added). Each new kernel was chosen with the official tuner (--libtype all, --preshuffle) and kept only when a multi-run ABBA head-to-head on MI355X gfx950 (50 warmup / 200 iters / 7 groups, median) confirmed >2% speedup over the previous kernel with bit- identical output (maxdiff=0). Most are CK 256x64x256x128 -> CKTile 192x256x128.

Representative speedups vs previous dsv4 kernel:
  wq_b   M=2048/4096/8192   1.42x / 1.31x / 1.36x
  wq_b   M=96..1984         1.15x .. 1.79x
  wq_b   M=6144..14336      1.33x .. 1.39x
  wqkv_a M=2048/4096/8192   1.27x / 1.23x / 1.16x
  wqkv_a M=416 / M=14336    1.37x / 1.28x

Buckets left unchanged: keys the tuner reproduced, ties (<2%), very large M where CKTile is unsupported (wq_b M>=40960 kept on CK), and decode-path buckets whose existing kernel uses asm/triton/flydsl (not covered by this tuner).

5440.title: [Config] [gfx950][DSV4] Tune a8w8 blockscale bpreshuffle shared-expert down/gate_up large-M
5440.body:
### What
Retune the DeepSeek-V4 FP8 block-scale **bpreshuffle** dispatch config on gfx950
for the two shared-expert GEMMs at large M:
- `shared_down` **(N=7168, K=3072)**, M = 1024…16384 (9 buckets)
- `shared_gate_up` **(N=6144, K=7168)**, M = 4096 (1 bucket)

These buckets were dispatching to **ck id13** (`256x64x256x128`, 64-wide M-tile),
which under-utilizes compute at large M. Switching to **cktile
`192x256x128`** (larger M-tile) is consistently faster.

### File
Only `aiter/configs/model_configs/dsv4_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle_tuned_gemm.csv`
(10 rows changed, no rows added/removed).

### Verification
Head-to-head ABBA (7 groups × 200 iters, warmup 50, median), gfx950 MI355X /
256 CU, isolated single GPU. Output **bit-identical** (maxdiff = 0).

| (N,K) | M | ck id13 (µs) | cktile 192x256x128 (µs) | speedup |
|-------|---|------|------|------|
| 7168,3072 | 1024 | 43.0 | 32.2 | 1.34× |
| 7168,3072 | 2048 | 73.0 | 61.0 | 1.20× |
| 7168,3072 | 4096 | 120.0 | 95.3 | 1.26× |
| 7168,3072 | 6144 | 173.8 | 129.2 | 1.35× |
| 7168,3072 | 8192 | 220.5 | 162.6 | 1.36× |
| 7168,3072 | 10240 | 276.1 | 194.9 | 1.42× |
| 7168,3072 | 12288 | 323.6 | 227.1 | 1.43× |
| 7168,3072 | 14336 | 379.5 | 278.9 | 1.36× |
| 7168,3072 | 16384 | 429.6 | 311.5 | 1.38× |
| 6144,7168 | 4096 | 206.3 | 182.4 | 1.13× |

Tuner: `gemm_a8w8_blockscale_tune.py --preshuffle --libtype all` (installed aiter
c16d44b9, whose bpreshuffle ck/cktile csrc is byte-identical to current main).
